title: Digital-system workshop
slide_intent: Make related design decisions visible together so a team can compare whether separate digital elements form a coherent system.
strategic_value: A shared view of interface studies can support the digital-platform consistency described in the Swisscom case study.
demonstration: A workshop photograph shows several people facing a wall of interface printouts, color studies and diagrams. A desk and plant frame the foreground.
practical_value: Review a system as a group of related artifacts; the photograph does not expose enough detail to reproduce its individual interface rules.

content_islands.name: Review wall
content_islands.spec: Fill the background with the photographed interface printouts, color studies and diagrams in their original arrangement.

content_islands.name: Working group
content_islands.spec: Keep the people in front of the wall to show the artifacts being discussed together.

content_islands.name: Workspace foreground
content_islands.spec: Retain the desk, plant and small letter blocks as the surrounding workshop context.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case-study text says the digital design system was developed to unify platforms and redefine the customer experience.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph demonstrates a team reviewing interface and color studies together; individual detailed rules are not legible.
